description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting within the WPEFramework namespace. It declares structures for warning events and reporting units, including control mechanisms for category exclusion and configuration.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, providing methods for category, serialization, deserialization, string representation, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, handling warning events, category information, and category list management.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects that manage exclusion and configuration of warning categories, inheriting from Core::Messaging::IControl.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Adds a category to the exclusion list.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets configuration for the warning reporting control.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the warning reporting control.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with a specified identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a warning category, including whether it is default, enabled, excluded, and its configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control object to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control object from the category list.
